Package Business.Managers

Class UserManager

java.lang.Object
Business.Managers.UserManager
public class UserManager extends Object
Manages user-related operations such as user login, registration, verification, and database interactions.

      public UserManager.Status loginUser(String usernameOrEmail, String password) throws BusinessException

      usernameOrEmail - The username or email of the user trying to log in.

    • registerUser

      public UserManager.Status registerUser(String username, String email, String firstPassword, String secondPassword) throws BusinessException, PersistenceException
      Registers a new user with the provided username, email, and password.
      Parameters:
      username - The username chosen by the user.
      email - The email address provided by the user.
      firstPassword - The password chosen by the user.
      secondPassword - The confirmation of the password chosen by the user.
      Returns:
      A status indicating the result of the registration attempt.
      Throws:
      BusinessException - if an error occurs during the registration process.
      PersistenceException - if an error occurs while interacting with the database.
